notes:
PERMITS-1 (2026-11-17). State air-permit search over 21 plants (VA 6, SC 3, PA 2, KS 2, CA 2, WV 2, NY 1, AZ 1, TN 1, MD 1). A hit is a permit or registration document that names welding at the plant's address. No score, status or plants.csv field was changed; one evidence row written (stated prospect_test, NNS Goose Creek). "No permit found" below is NOT evidence of no welding; prospect_test stays as the ledger has it.

Method per plant: EPA ECHO air service by ZIP, then ECHO all-program search by name and state, then ECHO DFR program list for each matched registry ID; then the state's public document search where one could be reached.

HIT (1 of 21):
- p-nns-goose-creek-sc: SC DES Permit Coverage search (apps.des.sc.gov/PermitCoverage, public, no account). General State Operating Permit for Surface Finishing GOP-0420-0180; its Permitted Equipment Summary v1.2 (coverage date 2022-06-23; revision log entries 2024-12-20 transfer of ownership/name change from W International SC LLC, and 2025-04-08 name change) lists at 2040 Bushy Park Road, Goose Creek: ELECTRIC ARC WELDING, equipment 03-WO 'Welding Operations - Welding Training Room and Facility WIde', subject to 40 CFR 63 Subpart 6X, with a Prism fume extraction dust collector; also plasma cutting tables, Voortman V808 and V704 machines, blasting booths and a paint booth. Date choice for the coordinator: coverage began 2022-06-23 (over 3 years ago), but the summary itself is v1.2 revised 2025-04-08 under the current owner (the row quote includes the revision record; a separate revision row would share claim_id and URL and be overwritten by merge_inbox, so it is one row), and SC DES's own permit listing gives Effective Date 04/08/2025; so the row is worded as current ("welds in-house"), not "as of the document date". Reword if the coordinator dates it by coverage. Archive save of the SC URL failed (web.archive.org tunnel closed); the endpoint serves the current summary, so a later v1.3 could replace the quoted text. No weld_processes or materials row: the summary says only 'electric arc welding' (a family, not a named process); the MIG/GMAW sentence and the 86,000 lb electrode limit are in the generic general-permit text, identical (cmp) for both permits fetched (NNS and Pegasus), so they say nothing about this site. Scores unchanged (prospect_test is not a score input).

NOT HITS, per plant (search described):
- p-keel-goose-creek-sc: SC DES lists Pegasus Steel LLC, 1 Alliance Drive, GOP-0420-0111 (Surface Finishing general permit, issued 2019-11-01). Its attachment is a one-page 2020-07-30 staff-decision letter (modified general permit) with no equipment summary; the permit PDF is the generic general permit. Welding not named for the site: unknown. (Lead: Pegasus Steel LLC also holds CM-0560-0438, 9801 Highway 78, Ladson, issued 2025-12-18, NAICS 332312; a different Keel site.)
- p-raycap-north-charleston-sc: no SC DES permit coverage under Raycap/STEALTH or at Palmetto Commerce Pkwy addresses near 7555 (searched by name and by city North Charleston/Charleston/Ladson/Summerville); no ECHO air record. Unknown.
- p-hapco-abingdon-va: ECHO ICIS-Air VA0000005119100059 (HAPCO/Division of Kearney National, 26252 Hillman Hwy, Operating, Synthetic Minor, NAICS 332312). VA DEQ documents unreachable (see source_failures). Unknown.
- p-fairlead-newport-news-va: ECHO ICIS-Air VA0000005170000119 'FAIRLEAD BOATWORKS', 99 Jefferson Ave, Operating, 80% Synthetic Minor, NAICS 336611 811490 (FRS name Davis Boat Works Inc; RCRA LQG). VA DEQ unreachable. Unknown.
- p-liebherr-newport-news-va: ECHO ICIS-Air VA0000005170000069 'LIEBHERR-AMERICA INC', registered at '4100 AND 4850 CHESTNUT AVE', Operating, 80% Synthetic Minor (address lead: the air registration covers two street numbers). VA DEQ unreachable. Unknown.

- p-nns-norfolk-va: no ICIS-Air record; FRS 110071737814 'NEWPORT NEWS SHIPBUILDING NORFOLK AUXILIARY CAMPUS', 500 Orapax Street (RCRA only, inactive). VA DEQ unreachable. Unknown.

Whether the campus has a VA air registration naming welding is NOT DETERMINED (VA DEQ unreachable). - p-heartland-fabrication-brownsville-pa: ECHO ICIS-Air PA000627609 (Operating, 80% Synthetic Minor), plus CEDRI and EIS records (CEDRI often carries 40 CFR 63 Subpart 6X metal-fabrication notices, which name welding: lead). PA eFACTS unreachable (TLS). No PA Bulletin notice found by web search. Unknown.
- p-sovereign-allentown-pa: FRS 110070308282 at 2027 South 12th St Building 507 with no program records; no ICIS-Air. PA eFACTS unreachable, so the state record was not checked. Unknown.

The permit itself sits on KDHE's site, which blocks the container. Unknown.
- p-metal-pros-wichita-ks: FRS 110070548167 at 3900 S Norman St (NPDES stormwater only); no ICIS-Air. Wichita's local air program not tested (web search only); state/local record not checked. Unknown.
- p-us-pole-palmdale-ca: ECHO air query for ZIP 93551 gives ICIS-Air 0900000006037R9500 'US POLE', registered at 680 West Avenue O (ledger 660; address lead), Minor, NAICS 331524. AVAQMD: no public permit search found by web search (not tested further). City of Palmdale CEQA Notice of Exemption (Minor Modification 23-005, 660 West Avenue O, applicant U.S. Pole Company): a ~25 ft dust collector on an existing industrial building; welding not named, so no row. Unknown.
- p-klein-ontario-ca: no ICIS-Air facility in the ECHO air query for ZIP 91761 (the name search returned 149 'Klein' records statewide; only the first 25 were read). SCAQMD F.I.N.D. backend down (503) on two attempts. Unknown.
- p-jh-fletcher-huntington-wv and p-tabor-princeton-wv: no ICIS-Air record in ECHO, but the WV DEP TAGIS air-quality facility layer (MapServer layer 7) lists 'J. H. Fletcher & Co., Huntington', 402 High St, WV DAQ facility ID 011-00148, and 'Tabor Machine Company, Princeton', 1176 Shelter Road, facility ID 055-00111 (both 'Mining Machinery and Equipment Manufacturing'). The layer does not name welding. WV permit documents sit in ApplicationXtender, which requires a sign-in (published shared credentials), so it was not used under the no-sign-in rule. Unknown.
- p-stony-brook-calverton-ny: no ICIS-Air facility in the ECHO air query for ZIP 11933 (name search too broad to read fully). NY DEC system not tested beyond web search; DEC permit PDFs at extapps.dec.ny.gov/data/dar/afs/permits/<DEC ID>.pdf do load in this container, so NY is usable by DEC ID. State record not checked. Unknown.
- p-cem-tec-phoenix-az: FRS 110001696781 at 3745 South 7th Avenue (RCRA only, inactive); no ICIS-Air. Maricopa County AQD not tested beyond web search; local record not checked. Unknown.
- p-tag-manufacturing-chattanooga-tn: FRS records at 6989 and 7080 Discovery Dr (RCRA, NPDES); no ICIS-Air (Chattanooga-Hamilton County Air Pollution Control Bureau IDs appear in ECHO for other plants, none for TAG). The Bureau's records not tested beyond ECHO; local record not checked. Unknown.
- p-pritchard-brown-baltimore-md: ECHO ICIS-Air MD0000002451002898 'PRITCHARD BROWN', 6501 Erdman Avenue, Operating, Minor. MDE posts only public-review dockets and Part 70 permits online; no minor-source permit document found by web search (MDE system not tested). Unknown.

Also tried: EPA WebFIRE CEDRI report search (cfpub.epa.gov/webfire) for Heartland and NNS: the results page returned an error page; not pursued. ECHO DFR WebFireDocuments/CAEDDocuments were empty for both.

Caution for the coordinator: absence from ECHO ICIS-Air is not absence from the state program. WV TAGIS lists Fletcher (011-00148) and Tabor (055-00111) as DAQ air facilities although ICIS-Air has neither. Every 'no ICIS-Air' line above means the state record was not checked unless a state system is named.
Not-found results are recorded here in notes, not as unknown evidence rows, following the permits-pilot file's convention.
